facts.summary: Updated Phase 1 data showed 38% response rate at recommended dose, below market hopes · Phase 1/2 · PC14586 in TP53 Y220C solid tumors · not yet approved
facts.indication: advanced solid tumors with TP53 Y220C mutation

evidence.summary: Confirmed overall response rate of 38% at Recommended Phase 2 Dose of 2000 mg daily (6/16 evaluable patients) reflective of the planned Phase 2 patient population (TP53 Y220C and KRAS wild-type)
evidence.safety: PC14586 achieved efficacy in heavily pretreated patients across multiple tumor types and was well tolerated with a favorable safety profile.
evidence.program_discontinued: PMV plans to initiate a registrational Phase 2 trial in early 2024.
